recommendation.description: Whether the two descriptions plausibly refer to the same item or service. Use INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when the supplied text does not support a confident view; that is a correct answer, not a failure.

confidence.description: Confidence in the recommendation. Must be between 0 and 1 inclusive.

explanation.description: One or two plain sentences a non-technical reviewer can read. Must be 400 characters or fewer. Do not mention prices, quantities, totals, tax, approval or any recommended action.

evidence.description: Between 1 and 4 short spans copied verbatim from the supplied descriptions. Each span must appear character for character in the description named by its source field.

text.description: A verbatim span from the named description.
